# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Stuffing the paper into the cup
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: If the source paper is not visibly stuffed inside the source cup, is there visible progress toward stuffing that paper into that cup?
node.criteria: Pass if the edited image shows the matched source paper being moved toward or into the matched source cup, but not yet visibly stuffed inside it. Fail if the matched objects are assessable and there is no visible progress toward placing the paper into the cup, or the paper is already visibly stuffed inside it. Unknown if the source objects cannot be reliably matched in the edited image, or their placement or movement cannot be assessed.
node.binding: Identify the requested paper and cup by their visual and contextual roles in the source image, allowing their appearance to change in the edited image. Count only visible progress toward stuffing that paper into that cup; unrelated edits do not count.

node_traces.evidence: The source shows a white paper and a blue cup. In the edited image, the paper has been moved over and partly into the matched cup, showing progress toward stuffing it, but it is not visibly stuffed inside.

fulfillment: The node’s binding is too vague to preserve object identity, and its dependencies allow a partial judgment from evidence that conflicts with the source/edited-image match. The source shows a white sheet and blue cup; the edited image shows a hand holding a blue printed item near a round object, with no reliable visual match to either source object. Do not treat the s2 claim of partial progress as established merely because it describes movement toward the target: require evidence that the edited item is the source paper and the round object is the source cup before crediting progress. Keep completion, progress, and unresolved identity distinct: if identity cannot be matched, return unknown rather than partial or no; do not infer absence of progress from that uncertainty. Review the support criteria and routing so completion is assessed independently, and partial/no is assigned only when the relevant evidence establishes those outcomes. The reference label is aggregate guidance, not proof that the edit made no progress. No transport, schema, or dependency failure is reported here.
